name: Treasure Hunter Scrope

intro.text: I've got a map, a shovel and a metal detector, and I will tell you with total honesty that I have found nothing.
You've got a map too? Sorry, that was my line.

win: Fine. Keep your treasure. I'll keep my hat.
after: Norman Island's caves are meant to hide pirate treasure. They hide very good snorkelling. I've had to settle.
